title: 第一章 春第二章 雌将
content_zh:
红彤彤的落日像一头投奔怒海的凶兽，无比辉煌，大地上的峰峦阴影光怪诡谲，似有未了情殇。
时起的风沙呼过，寸草不生，放眼处尽是起起伏伏的荒凉。
山坳里一群矿工忙碌不停，将地下深处开挖的土石排出，就近的山沟沟填了一条又一条。
日暮，光线逐降，炙烤的热感渐温和，秘伏在山谷工地周围的警戒人员陆续有了冒头张望迹象。
一张破木料拼凑的简陋躺椅被两人抬上了山顶放下，躺椅上一脸冷森森的清瘦中年人未老先衰，面对夕阳眯眼，抬手挥退左右方露惆怅神色，风掠花白须发，病恹恹倦态，身上衣着却是这里最得体的。
也只是一套正常人的衣裳，其他人，那些矿工，包括周围的守卫和刚抬他上来的人，说是穷的没裤子穿都不为过，大多都是几块破布之类的东西遮住羞处，脏兮兮的身子干瘦，蓬头垢面，这里找不到胖的人。
守卫和矿工的区别，除了手上有武器，再就是脸上罩着一只草编面具，加以胳膊上绑了黑布条来区别。以整块黑布撕成布条的行为，在这物资极度匮乏的流放之地已属奢侈。
山沟里倒掉土石，挑着担回归矿洞的矿工，肤色古铜是最浅色，像躺椅上的中年人那么白、那么干净的没有，大多赤脚。部分是真的没鞋穿，部分将草鞋挂在了腰上，不是特别硌脚的路宁愿磨脚皮也不愿过多磨损鞋，好在都习惯了，脚底板的皮厚。
当中有一高一矮两人则显得有些另类。
高矮只是相对来说，矮的对比旁人并不矮，只是个高的那人确实比正常人高的有点多。
时起的风沙呼面，偶吹开蓬头遮脸的垂发，哪怕露出的面容很脏，加之久未打理的胡茬，也掩盖不了两人脸上的青春气息。
其他矿工脸上是劳累后的麻木，另类的两人却盯上了山顶上的那个中年人，遥遥打量着，以至于走到矿洞口时，洞内有人迎面走出都未曾察觉，其他矿工都主动分开让路靠边走了，两人却是差点撞上。
来者甩着大袖快步而出，是个面带横肉的男子，名叫申尤昆，尽管上下衣裳不配套，还有不少补丁，却是这里唯二有整套衣裳穿的人。
申尤昆是此番矿洞开挖的主持人，就是脾气不太好，动辄打骂，受召而来的矿工都有点怕他，奈何人家有实力，能让大家每天有两顿干饭吃，还许诺了事后的报酬，一笔粮食！
申尤昆之前一直是这里的头号人物，直到刚刚不久前那个躺在躺椅上的中年人来了后，角色似乎立刻弯腰成了惟命是从的属下，所以一高一矮的两个年轻人才会特别留意观察那个中年人。
他们不认识那中年人，在这流放之地也从未见过，但却和申尤昆彼此认识，甚至是有过恩怨。
双方当面撞上后，两人不免有点紧张，确实也没想到会这样直接撞上，赶紧低头，让蓬乱的垂发遮面，大高个更是点头哈腰状，借机屈膝，企图掩饰一点自己的身高，算是个有自知之明的。
好在申尤昆的注意力压根不在他们身上，一到洞口就在四处打量外界，目光迅速锁定了一侧山顶上的中年人，不耐烦地一把拨开两人，一声毫不客气的“滚开”，径直从两人中间而过，快速朝目标方向大步赶去。
麻木的矿工们只是回头多看了一眼，没耽误继续前行，磨磨蹭蹭会有偷懒的嫌疑，监工的鞭子不会留情。
尾随的高矮二人相视一眼，皆暗松了口气，挑着担的大高个更是下意识拍了拍胸口，还好，还好，庆幸状。

山无草木，山体则不固。
上山的申尤昆脚下不时有沙石哗啦啦滚下，爬到孤零零的躺椅旁时，已是气喘吁吁，“舅舅，您怎么跑到了山顶吹风？您修为刚废，身体还很虚弱，风邪易侵，多多将养保重才是。”
气喘吁吁的他又何尝不是修为被废后，才被贬到了这流放之地自生自灭，只不过比他口中的舅舅早来几年而已。
舅舅名叫祁自如，盯着天际最后的辉煌走神般，似呓语，“你说要将这东九原给清场后才能行事，人都清干净了吗？”
下意识就要满口保证的申尤昆忽察觉到舅舅的话里似有深长意味，看了眼早已开工忙活了好些日子的山下，话到嘴边还是咽了咽，嗡声道：“差不多了。”
祁自如无动于衷的样子，“之前是你说东九原的人很难办，不清场难以保密行事，你说需要足够的物资才能清场，你应该知道把东西弄进这流放之地有多难，连张纸都很难进来，可我还是想尽办法帮你把物资渗透了进来。现在你已经开挖了，却告诉我说清场的差不多了，这个差不多是差多少？”
content_en:
The red sunset is like a ferocious beast that has fled into the angry sea, it is extremely brilliant, and the shadows of the peaks and mountains on the earth are strange and strange, as if there is an unfinished love.
The wind and sand blew by, not a blade of grass grew, and everywhere you looked you could see the ups and downs of desolation.
A group of miners were busy in the mountain col, discharging the earth and rocks excavated deep underground, and filling in the nearby ravines one after another.
As the sun sets, the light gradually drops, the scorching heat gradually becomes milder, and the security personnel lurking around the construction site in the valley gradually show signs of emerging and looking around.
A simple recliner made of broken wood was carried up to the top of the mountain and put down by two people. On the recliner, a thin middle-aged man with a cold face was aging prematurely. He squinted his eyes facing the sunset, raised his hands and waved away, revealing a melancholy expression. His hair and beard were gray in the wind, and he looked sick and tired, but he was dressed the most appropriately here.
It's just a set of normal people's clothes. The other miners, including the surrounding guards and the people who just brought him up, it's not an exaggeration to say that they are so poor that they have no pants to wear. Most of them have a few rags and the like to cover their shameful places. Their dirty bodies are thin and unkempt. There is no fat person here.
The difference between guards and miners is not only that they have weapons on their hands, but also that they wear a straw mask on their face and black cloth strips tied to their arms. The act of tearing a whole piece of black cloth into strips is already considered a luxury in this place of exile where supplies are extremely scarce.
The miners who returned to the mines after dumping the earth and rocks in the ravine had the lightest complexion of bronze, not as white and clean as the middle-aged man on the recliner, and most of them were barefoot. Part of it was because I really didn’t have any shoes to wear, and part of me had straw sandals hanging on my waist. The road that wasn’t particularly harsh on my feet would rather wear the skin off my feet than wear out my shoes too much. Fortunately, I was used to it, and the soles of my feet were thick.
Two of them, one tall and one short, looked a bit different.
Height is just a relative term. The short person is not shorter than others, but the tall person is indeed a bit taller than the normal person.
The rising wind and sand occasionally blew away the unkempt hair covering their faces. Even if the exposed faces were dirty and the stubble that had not been taken care of for a long time, they could not hide the youthful atmosphere on their faces.
The faces of the other miners showed numbness after exertion, but the other two people stared at the middle-aged man on the top of the mountain and looked at him from a distance. When they walked to the entrance of the mine, they didn't notice someone walking out of the cave. The other miners took the initiative to separate and move aside, but the two of them almost bumped into each other.
The visitor swung his big sleeves and walked out quickly. He was a man with a sinister face named Shen Youkun. Although his upper and lower clothes did not match and there were many patches, he was the only person here who wore a complete set of clothes.
Shen Youkun is the host of this mine excavation, but he has a bad temper and often beats and scolds. The miners who were summoned are a little afraid of him. However, he has the strength to give everyone two meals a day, and he also promised a reward afterward, a sum of food!
Shen Youkun had always been the number one person here, until the middle-aged man lying on the deck chair came not long ago. The character seemed to immediately bend and become a subordinate who obeyed orders, so the two young people, one tall and one short, paid special attention to the middle-aged man.
They did not know the middle-aged man and had never seen him in this place of exile, but they knew each other and had even had grudges with Shen Youkun.
After the two sides collided face to face, the two of them couldn't help but feel a little nervous. They really didn't expect to bump into each other directly. They quickly lowered their heads to cover their faces with their disheveled hair. The taller one nodded and bowed, taking the opportunity to bend his knees in an attempt to hide his height. He was a self-aware person.
Fortunately, Shen Youkun's attention was not on them at all. As soon as he arrived at the entrance of the cave, he looked around at the outside world. His eyes quickly locked on the middle-aged man on the top of the mountain. He pushed the two people away impatiently, said "get away" without politeness, passed directly between the two people, and quickly strode towards the target direction.
The numb miners just looked back one more time and moved on without any delay. If they dilly-dallyed, they would be suspected of being lazy.The workers’ whip will show no mercy.
The tall and short people who were following them looked at each other and secretly breathed a sigh of relief. The tall man carrying the load subconsciously patted his chest. It was okay, okay, and he was lucky.
There is no vegetation on the mountain, and the mountain body is not solid.
Sand and stones rolled down from time to time at Shen Youkun's feet as he climbed up the mountain. When he climbed to the lonely reclining chair, he was already out of breath. "Uncle, why did you go to the top of the mountain to blow the wind? Your cultivation has failed and your body is still very weak. Wind evil is easy to invade, so you should take good care of yourself."
He was panting, so he was demoted to this place of exile to fend for himself after his cultivation was abolished. He was just a few years earlier than the uncle he mentioned.
The uncle's name is Qi Ziru. He stared at the last glory in the sky and seemed to be murmuring, "You said that Dongjiuyuan must be cleared before we can act. Have everyone been cleared?"
Shen Youkun, who was about to make a promise subconsciously, suddenly noticed that there seemed to be a profound meaning in his uncle's words. He glanced at the foot of the mountain, which had been busy for several days, and swallowed the words before he said in a hum, "It's almost done."
Qi Ziru looked indifferent, "Before, you said that the people in Dongjiuyuan were difficult to deal with, and it was difficult to keep things secret without clearing the place. You said that enough supplies were needed to clear the place. You should know how difficult it is to get things into this place of exile. Even a piece of paper is difficult to get in, but I still tried my best to help you infiltrate the supplies. Now that you have excavated, you told me that the clearance is almost there. How close is this difference?"
